assertions.subject: Brief psychotic disorder
assertions.quote: If symptoms are present for less than 1 month, the condition is called a brief psychotic disorder

assertions.subject: Schizophreniform disorder
assertions.quote: If symptoms are present for more than 1 month but less than 6 months, a diagnosis of schizophreniform disorder is made

assertions.subject: Psychotic disorder not otherwise specified
assertions.quote: Psychotic symptoms that do not meet full diagnostic criteria for schizophrenia but are clinically significant are diagnosed as psychotic disorder not otherwise specified

assertions.subject: Schizoaffective disorder
assertions.quote: Schizoaffective disorder is diagnosed when a person has clear symptoms of schizophrenia for at least 2 weeks without active symptoms of depression or mania

assertions.subject: Major depression with psychotic features
assertions.quote: Major depression with psychotic features and bipolar disorder with psychotic features are diagnoses made when psychotic symptoms occur during the course of depression or mania only

assertions.subject: Bipolar disorder with psychotic features

assertions.subject: Psychotic disorder due to a general medical condition
assertions.quote: Psychotic disorder due to a general medical condition describes psychotic symptoms that are judged to be the direct result of a general medical condition

assertions.subject: Substance-induced psychotic disorders
assertions.quote: Substance-induced psychotic disorders have psychotic symptoms related to drug or alcohol ingestion

assertions.subject: Shared psychotic disorder
assertions.quote: Shared psychotic disorder, folie à deux, occurs when delusional symptoms from one person influence delusions, with similar content, in another person
